items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Michael McDonald is that the guy? Who’s the other guy? Oh Lord, with the raspy voice?

ctx.x: Well I’m improvising all the time. We improvise when I’m sitting in the chair, if I pull my coat, it’s all improvisation. If I play with my fingers, you improvise all the time. Maybe not in music. But that is what you do in music. And music you fold your arms, you cross your legs, you straighten out your knees so you can relax, you think about your wife, if you’ve got a girlfriend you think about her too. So it’s all improvisation. When you want to turn it into music it now has to gel into one musical definition.…
